title: What Is Anaphora? — Lesson and Activity
skills: define anaphora as a rhetorical and literary device
identify repeated words or phrases at the beginnings of successive clauses or lines
analyze how anaphora creates emphasis, rhythm, and cohesion
apply anaphora intentionally in persuasive and creative writing
alignment_note: Introduces anaphora as a form of deliberate repetition at the beginnings of successive clauses, sentences, or poetic lines. Supports rhetorical analysis, poetry analysis, persuasive writing, rhythm, emphasis, and author's craft across high school English courses.
